$comment: One public Runpod template per install preset. The website's picker maps each preset to its template (Runpod deploy links can only carry a template id + referral code, not env vars or volume size). `groups` become DOWNLOAD_*_MODELS=true/false; `volumeInGb` is sized for the models plus room for renders. deploy-template.mjs creates/updates all of them and records ids in presets.lock.json.
